request: Analyze GSE149405 for PMID 35291563 (Swimming attenuates tumor growth in CT-26 tumor-bearing mice and suppresses angiogenesis by mediating the HIF-1a/VEGFA pathway.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (rRNA-depleted, NovaSeq 6000) of subcutaneous CT-26 tumor tissue
final.sample_inclusion: 6 tumors per group randomly selected from 10 control and 10 swimming male BALB/c mice (S2.6.p1, S2.4.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 3 weeks of swimming (twice daily, 6 d/week, up to 30 min) on tumor-tissue gene expression in CT-26 tumor-bearing mice, swimming vs control (S2.5.p1, S3.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: swimming vs control (S3.2.p1; paper: 715 up / 629 down transcripts = 1344 DETs)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumor per independent mouse
final.paper_method: limma on StringTie transcript-level expression (S2.6.p1); KEGG ORA on DETs (S3.3.p1)
final.paper_results: 715 up / 629 down transcripts; Vegfa mRNA down; Stat3, Pdgfa, Pld2, Pik3r2 decreased; Hif1a and Kdr (VEGFR2) mRNA unchanged (S3.2.p1, S3.4.p1, S4.p4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Single two-arm exercise design. S2.6.p1 states limma with 'cut-off > 2; P < 0.05'; read as fold change > 2 (|log2FC| > 1) and raw P < 0.05 — no FDR is mentioned, and Table 1 lists raw P values only. Results are reported as transcripts (ENSMUST IDs in Table 1).

candidates.reason_rejected: 'cut-off' with value 2 conventionally refers to fold change; Table 1 top hits have |logFC| 5-9 so either reading is consistent there, FC>2 is the standard reading

checks: GEO contact institute (Fujian Univ. TCM) and author Jun Peng (S6.p1) match
12 samples = 6 control + 6 swimming as in S2.6.p1
tumor tissue, CT-26 cells, Mus musculus

ownership.reasoning: Paper cites GSE149405 explicitly; sample counts and tissue match.

alignment.reasoning: Merged tar columns are GSM<id>_<tumor id>; regex extracts the GSM id, which equals the metadata index (12/12 per inspect). Group taken from characteristics 'group' (control/swimming), consistent with titles control1-6 / swimming1-6.

matrix.reasoning: Per-sample files hold one decimal column; only 24% integer values, max 7145, median 0.37; data_processing: 'Supplementary files ... include FPKM values for each Sample' (StringTie). Gene-level (ENSMUSG) whereas the paper analyzed transcripts (ENSMUST). Paper input was StringTie expression, analyzed by limma.

design.reasoning: Randomized two-arm intervention (S2.4.p1); swimming vs control is the paper's contrast (S3.2.p1). Causal estimand. All male (S2.3.p1).

covariance.reasoning: Independent mice, one tumor each; no batch, lane or pairing recorded in GEO or the paper.

paper_route.reason: Only gene-level FPKM is deposited; transcript-level quantification is not available, so the paper's per-transcript DET table cannot be reproduced.

deviations: log2(FPKM+1) transform and expression filter (FPKM >= 1 in >= 6 samples) chosen here; paper does not state its transform or filtering

method.reasoning: FPKM is linear-normalized, not counts, so DESeq2/edgeR do not apply; limma on log2(FPKM+1) matches the paper's limma route on the available gene-level matrix.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule applied to gene-level features; paper counts are transcripts, so counts are not directly comparable.

threshold.reasoning: S2.6.p1 / FIG2: 'cut-off > 2, P < 0.05' -> FC > 2 and raw P < 0.05. Audit: BH FDR < 0.05, no FC rule.

caveats: Paper DETs are transcripts (ENSMUST); our features are genes (ENSMUSG); counts are not directly comparable.
Paper threshold uses raw P with no multiple-testing correction; audit FDR count reported separately.
Paper text says reads mapped to hg38 while GEO says GRCm38.92; the matrix uses mouse Ensembl IDs, so hg38 is treated as a typo.

study.reasoning: Paper reports 715 up + 629 down = 1344 transcripts; named genes: Vegfa, Stat3, Pdgfa, Pld2, Pik3r2 down; Hif1a, Kdr unchanged; Table 1 examples Nupr1 (down), Fgfr1, Clta (up).

discrepancies.data: GRCm38.92 per GEO data_processing; mouse Ensembl IDs

discrepancies.paper: 10 per group in the tumor study, 6 per group sequenced (S2.6.p1)

executions.name: grp_swimming_vs_control
executions.reasoning: Paper's limma two-group contrast on gene-level log2(FPKM+1), filtered to expressed genes.

executions.name: grp_swimming_vs_control_nofilter
executions.reasoning: Same model without the expression filter, since the paper states none.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports KEGG pathways (angiogenesis, hypoxia, VEGF) from DETs (S3.3.p1).
